records.text:
On June 3, 1932, Lou Gehrig hit four home runs in one game against the Philadelphia Athletics, the first player of the 20th century to do it.

Explore his story with the Lou Gehrig Fan Club:
https://lougehrigfanclub.com

photo.alt_text: Black-and-white photo of four baseball players standing side by side in a ballpark. The two in the middle wear Yankees jerseys and the two on the ends wear jerseys with a large "A". The third player from the left holds a glove.
